runtime.execution: Rust/Tokio provider/core/store; embedded fresh QuickJS workflow programs; OS shell jobs/CLI bridge providers and optional daemon/mobile surfaces.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns session SQLite, scoped memory/harness entries, child tasks and background jobs; consumes model/provider/MCP interfaces; fleet messaging requires daemon owner.

summary: Systems Rust agent with unusually direct model-authored multi-agent workflow scripts, durable fleet peer messages, context uncompact/rewind, editable supplemental harness and isolated model comparisons.

inspection.scope: Entry, turn admission/request/step dispatch, concrete registry/file/notebook/process contracts, actual workflow engine/host concurrency, persistent child/fleet dispatch, memory, compaction/rewind/replay/audit caps, refinement/rollback, duel and selected source tests. Large modules read in focused coherent segments.
inspection.limits: Source read only, reference not executed. Full browser/device/proxy internals, all provider bridges, assay/evaluation and OS process isolation not exhaustive. Reliability slogan is bounded by specific heuristics/oracles; no complete original audit or executable refit continuity. Configured program changes do not replace compiled outer loop.

actions.name: read_file / write_file / append_file / edit_file / multi_edit / apply_patch / delete_file / notebook_edit / list_dir / search / glob
actions.output: Content, diffs/errors; notebook edits clear stale outputs
actions.lifecycle: Awaited; read-only batches may run concurrently, mutations under preview/snapshot/policy
actions.authority: Workspace/extra roots confinement and effect/rules; notebook editing does not execute cells

actions.name: shell / shell_job
actions.output: Exit/output or durable workspace job PID/log/status
actions.lifecycle: Awaited bounded command; long job descriptor survives restart; poll call yields for repeated wait; PTY stdin closed
actions.authority: Shell policy/rules, job workspace resolution; no interactive live-input handle in traced contract

actions.name: web_fetch / web_search / browser / browser_network / proxy / proxy_network / device / device_logs / lattice
actions.lifecycle: Registered tools; particular browser/proxy/device lifecycle not fully inspected
actions.authority: Effect-based policy and enabled services; catalog scope explicit

actions.name: run_workflow
actions.input: JS script string; named agent options and host compositions
actions.output: JSON result, child progress and phase/log events, workflow outcome
actions.lifecycle: Fresh sandbox QuickJS; async host child calls share total/per-provider budget; no persistent variable realm
actions.authority: Model authors control flow; no ambient filesystem/network, registered host primitives only

actions.name: spawn_agents / send_to_agent / list_subagents / cancel_subagent
actions.input: Named tasks/concurrency/detached; child name/id prefix, follow-up message
actions.output: Independent persisted child outputs, live state or lifecycle error
actions.lifecycle: Tokio children; bounded depth/model pin inheritance; send reuses saved child context; detached results next parent boundary
actions.authority: Model delegation according to host agent definition and authority, not arbitrary external shared fabric

actions.name: message_session
actions.input: target unique name/id prefix, message, mode=follow_up|steer
actions.lifecycle: Durable queue before attempted delivery; steer outranks backlog at next turn boundary, never midstream
actions.authority: Daemon-provided live peer roster, unavailable bare CLI; recorded allowed without fresh tool permission

actions.name: remember / ask_user / update_tasks / present_plan / use_skill / manage_heartbeats
actions.input: Typed fact, question/tasks/plan/named skill; heartbeat label/interval/prompt
actions.output: Persistent memory/tasks/plan/user result or heartbeat records
actions.lifecycle: Stateful core boundary; pending plan awaits operator activation; model heartbeat slots separate from user
actions.authority: Model scoped owner; heartbeat cap/min interval; direct virtual dispatch may bypass general policy

actions.name: Session.compact / uncompact / rewind_to / checkpoint; replay_items_full
actions.input: Transform mode, stable DB seq/checkpoint or history request
actions.lifecycle: Compaction preserves originals soft-deleted; uncompact reload; rewind rolls files/context to boundary
actions.authority: Operator/program paths; precise model context repair API not traced

actions.name: /refine / Session.refine / refine_rollback; model pin/effort/mode controls
actions.input: Refinement instructions/scope; saved batch rollback; model/effort settings
actions.output: Applied/rejected scoped prompt/skill/subagent edits plus journal before/after rationale/expected outcome
actions.lifecycle: Automatic or manual refinement uses bounded trajectory; subsequent context uses entries; rollback recorded
actions.authority: Immutable base prompt; model-proposed DB edits, not executable replacement

actions.name: /duel / run_duel; model-authored saved .forge/workflows scripts
actions.input: Task and candidate routes; saved script
actions.lifecycle: Concurrent maximum three candidates; tests own worktree; outcome affects future routing
actions.authority: Operator merge/winner choice; no automatic claim of rigorous generalizable performance

actions.name: scripts/rebuild.sh
actions.output: Compiled binary and killed MCP wrappers ready to respawn
actions.lifecycle: Stops wrappers before/after compile; restart on next use
actions.authority: Developer shell, no quiescence verification/context outpost/kernel identity transfer

filesystem.detail: Structured workspace tools and edits; notebook cell editing distinct from persistent kernel execution.

processes.detail: Bounded shell/PTY or durable background jobs with workspace PID/log/status/stop; PTY input closed.

code_actions.detail: Model authors fresh JS workflow control flow over registered async host functions.

persistent_kernel.detail: Workflow creates fresh QuickJS AsyncRuntime each run; notebook action edits JSON only; no session-persistent code execution namespace traced.

standing_database.detail: Real internal scoped SQLite facts/harness/session state; memory capped/deduplicated, no arbitrary external shared research database action.

workflow_programming.detail: Native model script agent/parallel/pipeline/phase/log/workflow with shared semaphores and host/runtime limits; saved workflow composition.

multi_model.detail: Mesh child routes or explicit model pins, failover and same-task isolated candidate comparisons.

live_collaboration.detail: Daemon fleet message_session durably queues peer text with steer/followup modes, plus persistent child follow-up. Scope is live daemon fleet; bare CLI lacks this host.

concurrent_work.detail: Read-only batch join with original-order pairing; child tasks/workflow concurrency and duel worktrees; serial hooks/mutations constrain overlaps.

steering_interrupt.detail: Legal-boundary inbox/peer priority and detached cancellation; deadline adds reconciliation model turn rather than immediately quiescing all owned computation.

turn_redefinition.detail: Model-defined workflow programs and editable supplemental harness entries are powerful but compiled outer request/verification/refinement loop remains fixed.

compaction.detail: Round-aligned summaries/pre-post lifecycle, output age pruning; failed summarizer preserves state and operator uncompact restores retained original history.

context_repair.detail: Explicit uncompact/rewind restore stored history and snapshots across stable DB seq; exposed operator/program controls, not ubiquitous model-directed arbitrary lineage repair.

original_audit.detail: Tool audit args/results capped 64KiB; live ring 2000 and ~90-day pruning; CLI bridge provides summaries without raw output. Rich provenance not complete original everything.

audit_query.detail: Store/read full replay and tool audit provide query primitives; replay filters visibility and reconstructs success, not original event analytical view.

hot_change.detail: Named definitions loaded for workflow/followup, supplemental entries and model/effort changes; current core stays compiled and kernel fresh per workflow.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Concrete rebuild script kills MCP wrappers then compiles and kills remnants, expects respawn; no quiescent refit/context-outpost continuity.

remote_services.detail: Provider/MCP/tool traits and daemon HTTP peers support consumer composition; actual fleet host owns local sessions rather than external meta-project fabric.

self_improvement.detail: Continual Harness validates/applies/journals/rolls back model-proposed scoped prompt/skill/subagent entries; base prompt immutable. Duel measures task candidates/routing, not executable self-refit experiments.

complaints.detail: Not established in the inspected entry, model loop, action dispatch and state paths; no universal absence claim.

authority.detail: Bypass/AcceptEdits reduce ceremony, but built-in deny floor always overrides and Plan is hard read-only; virtual messages treated already allowed.

evaluation.detail: Duel isolated same-task comparisons record actual test status/diff/time/cost and operator choice; source workflow/phantom-claim tests have bounded oracles.

time_order.detail: Durable DB seq/peer queue before delivery, shared task permits and monotonic synchronous-slice budgets; no complete distributed global event audit clock.

evidence.claim: Rust Tokio CLI dispatch entry.
Turn admits workspace, drains finished detached children, prunes older output and builds route context.
Step-wise age/prune/compact then provider request and response recording; deadline adds one reconciliation model turn.
Actual complete_with request includes advertised specs/options/checkpoint; stream idle timeout and failed-attempt mesh outcome.
Read-only batch concurrent join then paired original-order persistence; hooks require serial path.
Tool API exposes effect/schema/full result and side-effect-free diff preview.
Exact native tool registration.
Native read_file schema and actual path/range reading entry.
notebook_edit manipulates cells and clears stale execution outputs; not notebook execution.
shell command/PTY/background/poll tool contract; PTY stdin closed.
shell_job actual list/status/log/stop dispatcher with workspace-scoped stored job descriptor.
run_workflow native JS agent/parallel/pipeline/phase/log/workflow host interface.
Agent host function routes child and shares global/per-provider permits, emits lifecycle/progress and final outcome.
Model run_workflow dispatch builds session context and invokes workflow runtime with configured quotas.
Fresh QuickJS AsyncRuntime per script, explicit host capabilities, heap and continuous synchronous compute limits.
Child routing pin inheritance and explicit override; independent model route.
Persistent child follow-up reloads stored history and appends new user message.
send_to_agent resolves previously spawned named child and re-resolves persona definition.
list/cancel detached child actual stateful dispatcher.
Daemon-only peer capability and follow_up versus steer queue priority; ordinary CLI lacks native fleet host.
Actual fleet send persists source/recipient/mode before host delivery attempt.
Mid-turn inbox drained only at legal boundaries; surface retains unconsumed prompts.
SQLite durable facts scoped project/global; duplicate salience and bounded scope count.
Model remember actually parses kind/text and stores scoped memory, optional embedding.
Compaction hooks, tool-round-aligned preserved tail and routed summarization input.
Failed compaction leaves transcript; uncompact reactivates stored originals/reloads full context.
Rewind DB sequence repairs compacted mapping then restores snapshots and soft-deletes subsequent messages.
Replay is visibility-filtered saved transcript; tool success reconstructed from error-prefix convention.
64KiB tool args/result cap, 90-day session pruning and 2000-event live ring.
Actual audit insertion caps args/results before transaction and sync revision.
CLI bridge tool completion has summary only, no raw output to retain/surface.
Continual Harness can add prompt/skill/subagent entries; immutable base prompt and separate memory ownership.
Refinement validates edits then scoped DB apply journals expected outcome and supports rollback.
Program API model pin/effort/deadline and related state mutations.
Developer rebuild kills MCP processes before/after compile, relies on fresh respawn; no context handoff/outpost.
Mode and rule precedence includes built-in deny floor even in Bypass; Plan read-only.
Duel native experiment runs same task in isolated worktrees, records test/diff/time/cost and operator winner; model routing feedback.
Parallel host-call test measures elapsed to distinguish concurrent versus serialized calls.
Infinite-loop interrupt and slow-host-await non-interruption source oracles.
Scripted prose-only mutation claim triggers repeated request and warning, not objective arbitrary completion proof.
Recurring same-session queued prompts separate model-owned and operator-owned heartbeat slots.

tests.focus: Real async host overlap and synchronous compute bound
tests.oracle: Promise.all two 50ms mocked host calls expected result plus elapsed <90ms distinguishes serial 100ms; susceptible timing-load false failures. Infinite loop gets interrupt within 10s; slow 500ms await does not trip 200ms pure-compute limit.

Provider repeatedly claims edits with no tool calls; asserts more than one request and explicit warning no mutation/not applied. This proves bounded guard behavior, not arbitrary true success inference.

strengths: Model-authored control flow with explicit host domain and shared concurrency budgets.
Durable daemon colleague message admission before delivery.
Uncompact and stable DB-sequence rewind survive model-visible summary transformation.
Refinement distinguishes scoped supplemental harness edits from immutable base/core.
Isolated same-task worktree comparison and explicit operator selection.
